nl: 用 antd 风格做文档管理：查询文档标题；表格展示文档标题、更新时间；文档是树形结构，子文档放在默认的 children 字段里；支持新增、编辑、删除。
nlEn: Document management with an Ant Design look: query by document title; the table shows document title and update time; documents are hierarchical with children under the default children field; supports add, edit and delete.
notes: AI-09 子项③: 显式写默认子键名 children（等价缺省）（antdv/schema）
